titulo.alumno:
«Персональные данные и согласие»
Personal data and consent

intro: In privacy notices, distinguish which data are collected, for what purpose, for how long and how consent can be withdrawn.

piezas.titulo: In privacy notices, distinguish which data are collected, for what purpose, for how long and how consent can be withdrawn.
texto: In privacy notices, distinguish which data are collected, for what purpose, for how long and how consent can be withdrawn.
Согласие на обработку данных does not mean unlimited permission for any use; look for exceptions and recipients.

frases.estudio: Сервис хранит адрес электронной почты для отправки уведомлений.
frases.alumno: The service stores the email address to send notifications.

frases.estudio: Пользователь может отозвать согласие в настройках личного кабинета.
frases.alumno: The user can withdraw consent in the settings of their account.

pregunta.texto: What is the email used for, according to the notice?

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence states the specific purpose.

opciones.texto: to sell it to third parties
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Сервис хранит адрес электронной почты для отправки уведомлений.»

frase.texto: Сервис хранит адрес электронной почты для отправки уведомлений.

opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The user can withdraw consent in the settings of their account.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Пользователь может отозвать согласие в настройках личного кабинета

piezas.traduccion: The user can withdraw consent in the settings of their account.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
